composition: North barrier arm parked in its dock, channel open · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The north arm of the Maeslantkering rests in its concrete dock, a white curved lattice of steel, while the Nieuwe Waterweg stays open beside it. The sky is overcast, about 15.1°C, with wind near 5.8 km/h. Industrial lamps light the steel. The arm is not swung across the channel, and the beach is a different scene.
